subject: 970 Fellsway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board continued its comprehensive permit hearing for a 289-unit residential development at 970 Fellsway, focusing on updated architectural and site designs following peer review. The hearing was continued to May 9, 2024, to address civil engineering and traffic reviews.

items.title: 970 Fellsway Comprehensive Permit Hearing (Case 40B-2023-01)
items.summary: The applicant presented revised architectural renderings, massing along Amaranth Avenue, open-air garage ventilation, roof equipment layouts, and potential public art opportunities, and the hearing was continued to May 9 after public comment regarding open spaces and neighborhood privacy.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Minutes
items.summary: Staff provided updates on upcoming 40B filings and peer review engagements, while consideration of past meeting minutes was postponed to allow members time to review.
